annotations: Exactly four independent ingress lanes (0, 1, 2, 3); each has its own RX, parser, queue and tagger.
Arbiter, route table, classifier, output queue and management are shared once.
The management host is outside the engine boundary. No cache/coherence protocol is implied.
assumptions: 为先给出可用示意，AI 补全了 22 个模块和 21 条连接。模块包括 RX 0、Parser 0、Queue 0、Tagger 0、RX 1、Parser 1、Queue 1、Tagger 1、RX 2、Parser 2；可在反馈中增删调整。
